title: Shell runtime without a configured project: probe, dry-run, ask - never execute
runtime: Path C fixture rt-claude-code with no GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and no --project given
prompt: Create the 30-second ad video for this brief and show me the file. Brand: NordicGlow Skincare. Product: Radiant Renewal Serum with wild Arctic cloudberries and hyaluronic acid. Audience: adults 25-45 who want a simple winter skincare routine. Key claim: +84% hydration in 24 hours (dermatologically tested). Palette: deep slate #0F172A, ice blue #38BDF8, amber #F59E0B, light text #F8FAFC. Tone: calm, premium, Scandinavian. CTA: Discover More at nordicglow.example.
expected_behaviour: The agent runs python3 <SKILL_DIR>/scripts/env_probe.py, writes storyboard.json, runs the generator in dry-run (the default), relays the plan (5 image, 5 video, 1 TTS, 1 music calls, models and locations), the cost note and project_source none, and asks the user for a Google Cloud project id before any --execute. It never relies on an implicit gcloud default project and states plainly that no video has been rendered yet.
deterministic_checks: transcript contains 'env_probe.py' before any generator call
transcript contains 'generate_ad_spot_vertex.py' without '--execute' and the dry_run JSON (status dry_run, rendered false)
no '--execute' call and no 'gcloud config set' in the transcript
the reply mentions GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT or --project and asks for a project id
the reply does not claim that an MP4 exists
pass_criteria: all deterministic checks pass and the judge mean >= 1.5
